notes: Source: StockAnalysis.com annual income-statement and cash-flow-statement pages, fetched 2026-11-13 (84 pages, all HTTP 200). No currency conversion, nothing computed, nothing filled from memory or other sites.

COVERAGE GAP: the free pages serve only the 5 most recent fiscal-year columns (plus TTM, not recorded). FY 2017 through FY 2019/2020 are NOT available from these pages and are absent from 'years' (not null-filled). Page metadata (full_count) indicates up to 10 annual periods exist for most companies, but they are not in the served page; no other endpoint was queried.

All values (income and cash-flow lines) are taken from the data payload embedded in each page (financialData block), which is in raw currency units; divided by 1,000,000 and rounded the way the page displays them ('Financials in millions <currency>': whole millions when |value| >= 1,000, two decimals below that). Every displayed-column value was cross-checked against the server-rendered HTML table where the row is rendered (income rows, Operating Cash Flow, and on most pages capex/FCF).

One extra earlier year per company (flagged "not_a_displayed_column": true, period_end null) comes from the embedded prior-year comparison block the page uses to compute growth rates; it is not a visible column. Drop those entries if only displayed columns are wanted.
Field mapping: revenue=revenue, gross_profit=gp, operating_income=opinc, net_income=netinc, operating_cash_flow=ncfo, capex=capex (page shows negative; stored positive), fcf=fcf.
Years are keyed by the page's fiscal-year label ('FY 2022' -> "2022"); for offset fiscal years see period_end and per-company notes.
